notes: Boot harl_a13 with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0. Hold dedicated input 88 (DS-5, the cabinet wiring diagram's UPPER RIGHT FLIPPER BUTTON on CN6-7) in attract mode, then insert three coins on the center slot (public 5), press Start (54), emulate the serve (trough position 11 empties, the ball rests on the shooter lane switch 16, the Launch button 53 is pressed and the ball leaves), hold 88 twice during play, then hold the right cabinet button 8 (the USA up/down post button) as the control that raises the up/down post 23, and finally hold 88 once more and drain the ball.
